The sniff tool is just a no-op echo adapter here — there's no real board connected, no network access, and no actual postings data being returned. It literally echoed back the string I sent it, confirming there's nothing real to hunt in this territory.

Since there's no live board adapter (`P5`) behind "mock-gym" and no postings data is actually retrievable, I can't gather any real postings worth a human verdict. This isn't a case of "zero relevant results after a real search" — it's that the territory has no working data source at all.
